senses.gloss: मि vt. 5U (pres. मिनोति, मिनुते) 1. To cast, to throw, to scatter; 2. to measure; 3. to observe, to perceive. (This root is rarely used in classics.)
मी (I) vi. 4Ā (pp. मीत; pres. मीयते) To perish, to die.
मी (II) vt. 9U (pres. मीनाति, मीनीते) 1. To injure, to hurt, to kill; 2. to violate; 3. to lessen, to diminish; 4. to go astray (Rarely used in classics).
मी (III) vt. 1P, 10U (pres. मयति, माययति-ते) 1. To go, to move; 2. to understand, to know.
